$comment: Failure-taxonomy registry. Each gold case's notes.md lists the traits it exhibits; the eval runner's coverage report asserts every trait has >=1 verified case that the candidate model gets right. Selecting gold documents by trait (not convenience) is what makes a green gate mean something. Add a trait when a NEW production failure mode is found; add a gold case that exhibits it.

points_grading.description: grading rows are in points, not percentages; every weight_pct must be null

percent_grading.description: grading rows are percentages; every points must be null and the rows sum to ~100

checksum_row.description: a 'Total Points'/'TOTAL 100%' summary row that must be EXCLUDED from grading[]

extra_credit_row.description: an extra-credit row that must go to policies.extra_credit, never grading[]

makeup_in_grading_notes.description: the make-up policy is hidden in a grading-table note, not under a policy heading

empty_heading_null.description: a section heading (e.g. Late Work, Instructor-Defined Outcomes) with no content under it -> null, never the next section's text

link_only_materials.description: Required Materials is only a bookstore link; required_materials must be [] (no invented titles)

named_textbook.description: a textbook is named with title/author/ISBN -> a required_materials entry with raw_text verbatim

inclusive_access.description: materials provided free / no purchase required -> inclusive_access true

duplicate_raw_labels.description: multiple grading rows share one label (e.g. three 'Speeches') and must stay separate rows

mixed_bucket_other.description: a grading row mixes item types (Quizzes/Assignments) -> canonical_type 'other', count null

sum_mismatch_medium_confidence.description: grading totals don't reconcile with the letter-grade scale; record it, set confidence medium, never silently fix

contradictory_policy.description: a policy contradicts the document (in-person text on an online section); copy verbatim, flag, confidence medium

opaque_label.description: an unexplained grading label ('Updated and Materials'); keep verbatim, map to 'other', note the ambiguity

office_hours_present.description: office hours are printed -> office_hours verbatim (populated, not the null default)

two_part_final.description: a two-part final exam; one final_exam row, count 2, both parts in notes

plagiarism_policy.description: an academic-integrity/plagiarism statement -> policies.ai_plagiarism even when AI is not mentioned

one_of_prereq.description: 'X or Y' prerequisite -> one prerequisites entry whose one_of lists both, plus verbatim raw_text

crosslist_or_trap.description: a cross-listing 'either A or B' note that must NOT be parsed as an alternative prerequisite

no_prereqs.description: no prerequisites stated -> prerequisites [] (empty list, not null)

tccn_present.description: 'Texas Common Course Number' marking -> tccn set

wecm_not_tccn.description: 'WECM Course Number' or 'Local Need Course' is NOT a TCCN -> tccn null

is_core.description: explicit Core Curriculum marking -> is_core true + core_component_area (CB0xx)

cb_approval.description: a Coordinating Board Academic Approval Number -> cb_approval_number verbatim

line_shredded_links.description: catalog text shreds a requisite across lines; reassemble before parsing

fixed_groups.description: requirement blocks with explicit 'take all' course lists -> slot_kind fixed

choose_group.description: a 'choose from' group with a credit target -> slot_kind choose

placeholder_slot.description: a 'SUBJ XXXX' wildcard slot -> slot_kind placeholder, wildcard kept verbatim in courses[]

exclusions.description: a combination ban ('cannot use both X and Y') -> exclusions[] verbatim

semester_sequence.description: groups organized by Semester 1/2 with per-semester credit totals

footnote_rule.description: an asterisk footnote (capstone/co-req) attaches as a rule on the footnoted group

cv_no_course_codes.description: a CV with credentials but no course codes -> courses_taught []

cv_no_email.description: no email/vita link printed -> null each

identity_mismatch.description: the document contradicts the context identity (different code/term) -> confidence low

garbled_text.description: OCR/PDF mangling (ligatures, hyphenation, shredded lines); adversarial junk case
